newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur fuel slumps, high sulphur steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur fuel slumps, high sulphur steady.

text.p: NWE low sulphur fuel oil prices fell on Wednesday but stabilised after a late technical rally on Brent futures, traders said.
Offers of $92 fob in Europe were heard early in the day, $3 off from Tuesday on the back of falling crude prices, but there were no takers and trading interest evaporated later.
Swaps showed prices holding steady, dealers added.
High sulphur barge prices pegged up $1, with trades done at $82.50 and $83 fob ARA. Dealers said the market was quiet with average bunkering interest.
High sulphur cargo prices held steady.
They shrugged off news that the European commission was proposing to strictly limit the use of the fuel in power stations from the start of 2,000.
High sulphur burners said they needed more details of the plans, which have many exceptions and are designed to cut emissions that cause acid rain, before they would react.
Business was quiet with just a Danish buyer heard interested in taking high sulphur cargoes at $80 a tonne delivered.
There was more activity in the Med, where high sulphur buyers were reported combining purchases for shipment to the Far East where arbitrage has opened up.
